verdict.rationale: Training-data opt-out is a fair privacy question for a hosted AI model provider, so the axis applies. No DeepSeek documentation in the pack describes a setting, policy, or account control that keeps user data out of model training. The only on-topic item is a community report that OpenRouter flags this provider as one that may use prompts and completions to train new models, which points against the capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
